result:
The proposed answer, (n+1)/3, is likely wrong. The solution only recalls the result from memory and gives no derivation, so I could not verify it directly.

My own recollection of the relevant paper (on rainbow C4 in edge-colored triangle-free graphs) is that the sharp condition is δ^c(G) ≥ (n+2)/3 for sufficiently large n, not (n+1)/3. I am fairly but not fully certain of this.

VERDICT: REJECT
